title: Filter and sort automation tasks: a real browser demo

steps.title: Inspect the task board
steps.narration: This local sample app contains four automation tasks. We will filter them by technology and then sort the visible results. The footage is an actual browser recording, not a generated screenshot.

steps.title: Filter for Python
steps.narration: Type Python into the search field. Only the API checks and CSV validation tasks remain. The match count changes to two, so we can verify the visible result immediately.

steps.title: Restore and sort
steps.narration: Clear the filter, then sort by name. All four tasks return in alphabetical order. A useful software demo shows both the user action and the observable outcome.
